svg.title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Ready Operating Desk
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-launch-sprint; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Ready Operating Desk; subtitle: Four weekly milestones prepare the business for a 2–5 month sales cycle.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: This sprint establishes readiness, not a promised first award. Use synthetic or properly authorized test records; do not dispatch paid passenger or specimen work before applicable credentials, agreements, and service requirements are satisfied.; caption: Preserve the canonical annual cases: Conservative $250,000 gross and $30,000 profit; Base $925,000 and $166,500; Scaled $1,600,000 and $384,000. The sprint does not forecast those results.; stages: label: Days 1-7: define the service boundary; value: Complete territory, payer, provider, and service requirement maps; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose initial NEMT transport levels and courier specimen classes. Document enrollment requirements, insurance coverage, labor classification, pickup windows, and accountable exception contacts.; label: Days 8-14: configure the evidence path; value: Demonstrate order intake through dispatch, custody, and billing records; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Configure dispatch roles, GPS events, barcode custody records, required information agreements, and payer-specific billing outputs. Test missing authorization and missed pickup cases with controlled records.; label: Days 15-21: validate capacity and unit economics; value: Finish provider-backed route quotes and settlement timing models; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Model 45% retained share: Conservative $112,500 retained with $30,000 profit at 26.67%; Base $416,250 retained with $166,500 profit at 40.0%; Scaled $720,000 retained with $384,000 profit at 53.33%. Gross margins remain 12%, 18.0%, and 24%, respectively.; label: Days 22-30: rehearse and pursue scoped awards; value: Complete exception drills, account proposals, and operating handoffs; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Rehearse driver absence, disputed trip evidence, missed STAT pickup, and late remittance. Assign the four core seats and define when the two Scaled seats are needed. Submit proposals without treating unsigned pipeline as revenue.

text.title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Ready Operating Desk
text.tspan: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Ready Operating Desk

circle.title: label: Days 1-7: define the service boundary; value: Complete territory, payer, provider, and service requirement maps; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose initial NEMT transport levels and courier specimen classes. Document enrollment requirements, insurance coverage, labor classification, pickup windows, and accountable exception contacts.

text.title: Complete territory, payer, provider, and service requirement maps

circle.title: label: Days 8-14: configure the evidence path; value: Demonstrate order intake through dispatch, custody, and billing records; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Configure dispatch roles, GPS events, barcode custody records, required information agreements, and payer-specific billing outputs. Test missing authorization and missed pickup cases with controlled records.

text.title: Demonstrate order intake through dispatch, custody, and billing records

circle.title: label: Days 15-21: validate capacity and unit economics; value: Finish provider-backed route quotes and settlement timing models; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Model 45% retained share: Conservative $112,500 retained with $30,000 profit at 26.67%; Base $416,250 retained with $166,500 profit at 40.0%; Scaled $720,000 retained with $384,000 profit at 53.33%. Gross margins remain 12%, 18.0%, and 24%, respectively.

text.title: Days 15-21: validate capacity and unit economics
Finish provider-backed route quotes and settlement timing models

circle.title: label: Days 22-30: rehearse and pursue scoped awards; value: Complete exception drills, account proposals, and operating handoffs; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Rehearse driver absence, disputed trip evidence, missed STAT pickup, and late remittance. Assign the four core seats and define when the two Scaled seats are needed. Submit proposals without treating unsigned pipeline as revenue.

text.title: Days 22-30: rehearse and pursue scoped awards
Complete exception drills, account proposals, and operating handoffs

Assumptions: This sprint establishes readiness, not a promised first award. Use synthetic or properly authorized test records; do not dispatch paid passenger or specimen work before applicable credentials, agreements, and service requirements are satisfied.
